mentions.name: Slickfast
mentions.description: A JSON-input SVG rendering core written in pure JavaScript, built for agentic workflows, available as a free open-source MCP server that runs locally. It renders about 140,000 SVG charts per second; demo use cases include live GitHub dashboards on repo homepages, with templates available on the project's GitHub.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a JSon input>pure javescript svg native render core, thats made for agentic work flows. free open source MCP, runs locally.

Our rendercore does like 140,000 charts a second svg.

Live github dashboards on your repo homepage is one of our demo cases. templates are on our github.
